verdict.rationale: Grafana maintains a dedicated OpenTelemetry documentation page describing OTel-based collection of metrics, logs, traces, and profiles, and Tempo explicitly supports the OpenTelemetry protocol for trace ingestion alongside Jaeger/Zipkin. This demonstrates first-class OTLP/OTel support across the observability stack. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a direct OTLP ingestion endpoint for metrics/logs (vs. via Alloy collector), and independent/hands-on corroboration of OTLP send reliability.
